T-Display S3 Programs

2026-11-13 10:58 PM

In ELEC3020 Embedded Systems, we were provided a LILYGO T-Display S3 with these specs:

  • ESP32 microcontroller (plenty fast for everything I've done)
  • 1.9-inch LCD screen with 16-bit colour (non-touch version)
  • Two programmable buttons
  • Programmable using Arduino IDE (C/C++)

The microcontroller was required for the Sumo Bot, the group project in that unit. Anyway, I liked it so much I bought a second one, which came with a nice 3D printed case.

In my spare time I've made a bunch of tiny toy programs (~100-200 lines) that run on the T-Display S3. The repos are all public.

  • Diffusion-limited aggregation simulation that doubles as a countdown timer
  • 2-channel music player with piezo buzzers (plays MEGALOVANIA and The Legend by Toby Fox)
  • Snake game, rocket game, time data plotter and a bunch of other things
